title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES PROMOTING THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE PHILIPPINE FILM INDUSTRY, STRENGTHENING THE FILM ACADEMY OF THE PHILIPPINES FOR THE PURPOSE

text.en:
Reorganization of the FAP. The FAP is hereby placed under the
administrative supervision of the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI).
The FAP shall be governed by a Board of Trustees ("Board") which shall be
composed of the following:
Chairperson
Co-Chairperson
:Director General, FAP
Secretary, DTI
Representative, Office of the President;
Secretary, Department of Labor and Employment;
Director General, Technical Education and Skills
Development Authority (TESDA);
Chairperson, National Commission for Culture and the Arts
Chairperson, Film Development Council of the Philippines
Two (2) Private Sector Representatives (PSRs).
The Chairperson, who is also the Director General, shall be appointed by the
President, and shall have the rank of Undersecretary. The Chairperson should possess
technical and creative expertise in the various fields of motion picture arts and
sciences. The Chairperson shall be in-charge of managing the day-to-day operations
of the FAP, and shall be assisted by six (6) immediate support staff pursuant to the
Civil Service Commission and Department of Budget and Management (DBM)
Organization and Staffing Standards and Guidelines.
The FAP shall elect among themselves a Vice-Chairperson who shall assist the
Chairperson and Co-Chairperson in the performance of their duties and functions.
The PSRs shall be appointed by the President upon the recommendation of the
Chairperson and Co-Chairperson. The PSs shall come from reputable representative
guilds, organizations, and/or associations in the Philippine Film Industry.
The existing units of FAP shall be reorganized consistent with the new structure
provided under this Order, subject to existing laws, rules and regulations. In this regard,
the current officials and personnel of FAP, if any, are hereby directed to immediately
turn over all properties and assets, as well as necessary documents and information,
to the FAP Board herein created.
2

The National Film Awards. The FAP shall have the primary function
of giving due recognition to outstanding motion pictures, artists and relevant
stakeholders with the end in view of revitalizing and further promoting the Philippine
Film Industry.
In this regard, the FAP is hereby directed to establish and organize a prominent
annual National Film Awards which shall recognize, promote, and celebrate
world-class talents and outputs of Filipinos in motion picture arts and sciences. The
awards categories, criteria, mechanics, and prizes for the National Film Awards shall
be determined by FAP, subject to existing laws, rules and regulations.
The FAP may collaborate with the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority,
Cultural Center of the Philippines, and such other relevant government agencies
relative to the establishment of the National Film Awards.
In addition, the FAP is hereby authorized to establish an independent committee
for the selection of official Philippine nominees to the Academy Awards or the Oscars
and other similar international awards, subject to existing laws, rules and regulations.

Capacity Building, Educational Programs, Assistance, and
Other Incentives. Consistent with RA No. 11904 and RA No. 9167, the FAP shall
collaborate with the DepEd, TESDA, FDCP, Commission on Higher Education, and
Philippine Creative Industries Development Council, as well as the private sector,
academe, and such other relevant government agencies, in the provision of programs,
trainings, and other forms of support towards the welfare and professionalization of
film workers in the Philippine Film Industry.

Convergence. The FAP is hereby directed to guide, assist, and
steer representative guilds, organizations and/or associations in various creative and
technical sectors towards the professionalization of the Philippine Film Industry. In this
regard, the FAP may consult representative guilds, organizations, and/or associations
or invite them as resource persons, as may be necessary, for the effective
implementation of this Order.
As may be necessary, the FAP shall likewise collaborate and coordinate with
international organizations and other relevant government agencies and offices, such
as the FDCP, NCCA, Department of Tourism, Department of the Interior and Local
Government, Movie and Television Review and Classification Board, Intellectual
Property Office of the Philippines, and local government units, with the end in view of
professionalizing and promoting the Philippine Film Industry.

Authority to Accept Assistance and/or Donations. The FAP is
hereby authorized to accept donations, contributions, grants, bequests or gifts from
domestic or foreign sources, for purposes relevant to its mandates and functions,
subject to existing laws, rules and regulations.

Organizational Structure and Staffing Pattern. The Chairperson
shall determine the organizational structure, appropriate staffing pattern, and
corresponding qualification standards for all positions in the FAP, and submit the same
for review and approval of the DBM, subject to existing laws, rules and regulations.
3

Pending the approval of the organizational structure and staffing pattern, the
FAP may tap into the existing personnel of its member-agencies to ensure the effective
implementation of this Order.

Implementing Guidelines. The FAP shall issue the necessary
guidelines for the effective implementation of this Order, which shall include the
following, among others: (a) guidelines for the selection of the PSRs; (b) other duties
and functions of the officers of the FAP Board; and (c) rules for the conduct of meetings
of the FAP Board.

Funding. The funding requirements for the initial implementation of
this Order shall be charged against the current and available appropriations of the
member-agencies of the FAP. The DBM is hereby further directed to identify other
appropriate funding sources to ensure the effective implementation of this Order.
The funding requirements necessary for the continued implementation of this
Order shall be included in the budget proposal of FAP and its member-agencies,
subject to the usual budget preparation process.

Separability. If any part or provision of this Order is held
unconstitutional or invalid, other parts not affected thereby shall continue to be in full
force and effect.

Repeal. All orders, rules and regulations, and other issuances or
parts thereof which are inconsistent with the provisions of this Order are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon its
publication in the Official Gazette or a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 2nd
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Four.
day of October
By the President:
KUCAS P. BERSAMIN
Executive Secretary
Office of the President
MALACAÑANG RECORDS OFFICE
CERTIFIED COPY
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
